items.text: Adults 21 and over may possess up to 1 ounce of useable cannabis bought from a licensed retailer. Opening or using cannabis in public or in view of the public (parks, sidewalks, restaurants, federal land) is illegal; private use where the owner allows.

laws.rule: Adults 21 and over (residents or not, with government ID) may buy and possess 1 ounce of usable cannabis, 16 oz of solid edibles, 72 oz of drinks and 7 g of concentrate. Public use is not allowed. It is illegal to take cannabis out of Washington, including on a plane; in a car it must stay sealed and in the boot. Cannabis remains illegal under US federal law, including on federal land such as national parks.

layers.process: Overnight use in the Enchantments needs a permit from 15 May to 31 October (self-register at the trailhead outside those dates). Advance lottery runs each February (exact 2026 dates not on the page). Fees: US$6 (about A$8.50) lottery application, non-refundable; US$5 (about A$7) per person per day. Zones: Core Enchantment, Snow Lake, Colchuck Lake, Stuart Lake, Eightmile/Caroline. Groups up to eight including stock; one permit per person per season; no dogs. Leavenworth Ranger District 509-548-2550. Fees in US dollars; A$1 = USD 0.7040 (RBA, 30 Oct 2026), so US$1 is about A$1.42.
